body: Crypto diagnostics contract: every decrypt line goes through VibeLog category 'crypto' with truncated ids (chat=prefix12, msg=suffix12), gated by ChatEngine.cryptoLogOnce(event:messageId:) so reparses cannot flood, and NEVER carries key material or plaintext — only byte/char lengths, slot letters k/s/g, and field NAMES. NSLog does not reach the in-app export, so diagnostics must not use it. Never name a metadata key privateKey/session/token/email/phone: VibeLogRedactor scrubs values by key fragment (it was turning present/MISSING into an identical 7-char placeholder).
author: Vibe Team
